probe_method: Take median RGB of image corners as opaque background; threshold maximum per-channel difference >18; the edited sleeve/hand content reaches the image boundary, so the entire edge-touching crop is retained and contain-fit with LANCZOS into 45x48; nearest-neighbor 8x display. This probe includes sleeve and is not a hand cutout or fit.
